requirements.requirement: The system must normalize all provider overall scores to a common scale (0–100) when input scores differ in range.
The system must normalize individual measure scores across providers using a consistent method defined by the S1 schema contract.
The system must compute a ranked ordering of providers based on normalized overall scores.
The system must assign equal ranks to providers when their normalized overall scores are identical.
The system must calculate per-measure deltas between providers as absolute differences in normalized scores.
The system must identify the highest-scoring provider for each measure and mark it as a relative strength.
The system must identify the lowest-scoring provider for each measure and mark it as a relative weakness.
The system must generate a comparison summary object containing normalized scores, rankings, and per-measure deltas for all providers.
The system must preserve original (non-normalized) scores alongside normalized values in the output data structure.
The system must handle comparison of at least two providers and scale to more than two without logic changes.
The system must exclude measures from delta calculations when a provider lacks data for that measure.
The system must flag measures with missing data for any provider in the comparison output.
The system must default normalized scores to null when input scores are non-numeric or invalid.
The system must not crash when encountering null, undefined, or malformed score inputs.
The system must recompute normalization and ranking deterministically given the same input dataset.
The system must ensure that normalization does not invert score meaning (i.e., higher normalized score always represents better performance).
